name: scua
description: State-scoped semantic computer use for desktop applications and browser-page roots.

interface.shortDescription: Semantic computer use without input takeover.
interface.longDescription: Give Codex a generic, state-scoped UI contract backed by native accessibility, immutable cached observations, verified actions, per-resource scheduling, and independent visual agent cursors.
defaultPrompt: Use SCUA to complete this task in a desktop app.
Inspect the available UI roots and operate the right one.
Use SCUA without taking over my cursor or keyboard.
